menu-board.title: The paddock board
menu-board.alt: The MOTOBOUND paddock board: four discipline plates, the venue sheet with its line-art map and the option dials, with the formula car under studio light.
menu-board.note: full game build; the paddock rail has RECORDS

wildcard-board.title: The Wildcard Series board
wildcard-board.alt: The Wildcard Series board: a list of mismatched machine and venue events beside the programme page of one event with its map, weather and medal ladder.
wildcard-board.note: event descent-in-the-cloud selected; no medals yet

formula-fog-golden.title: Formula car in fog at golden hour
formula-fog-golden.alt: A formula car at speed on the Vellamar circuit in dense golden fog, kerbs streaking past on the left and a grandstand fading into the haze.
formula-fog-golden.note: held live (pause) at t=80 s, 45 m/s on Vellamar; the fog preset is dense and flat, so this shows the weather rather than a hero composition. Keep as the fog shot, replace if a better frame is taken on a GPU

gp-corner.title: GP bike through a fast corner
gp-corner.alt: A GP motorcycle rider hangs off the bike through a fast corner, seen from behind with motion blur, forested mountains and a grandstand behind.
gp-corner.note: held live (pause) at speed with the rider hung off the bike; the lean at the redrawn frame is -0.26 rad, so it is a fast corner, not the deepest lean

motocross-jump.title: Motocross on the loam start straight
motocross-jump.alt: A motocross rider in a number 2 jersey accelerating up the loam start straight of a hillside course toward a grandstand, tyre ruts in the dirt and clouds above.
motocross-jump.note: the poll triggered on a take-off (airborne, 0.19 s) but the drawn frame is the rider on the start straight at the crest of a roller: do NOT caption it as a big jump

snow-pass.title: Trophy truck on the snow pass
snow-pass.alt: A green trophy truck with an exposed roll cage and spare wheel driving away along a snow-dusted mountain road, snowy pines on both sides under a hazy blue sky.
snow-pass.note: trophy truck (DX-8) on Col d'Argent in snow, held at 8.7 m/s

night-street-rain.title: Wet street circuit under the lamps
night-street-rain.alt: A blue touring car with a rear wing drives down a wet city street circuit between lit office blocks and street lamps, its headlights glinting on the rain-slick asphalt.
night-street-rain.note: touring car on Neon City, LIGHT night + rain; reads as dusk with the lamps on

results-board.title: The results board
results-board.alt: The results board after a four-car race: second place highlighted with race time and gap, the classification table with lap times, the podium, a next-step card for the braking licence and buttons for replay, race again, share card and telemetry.
results-board.note: a 1-lap, 4-car race driven by the in-game AI DRIVER (G) to reach the board: a layout shot, not a human result

photo-studio.title: Photo mode and livery studio
photo-studio.alt: The photo and livery studio on the Aurel grid: the formula car with two crew beside it, and the camera, filter, lens and exposure controls down the right.
photo-studio.note: real photo studio on the Aurel grid (loads the full venue from the menu); the capture took 9 minutes on software GL

festival-dawn.title: The festival town in low sun
festival-dawn.alt: A white electric hypercar drives down a main street of the festival town, lined with brick and plaster buildings and shopfronts, a pink event beacon ahead under a low warm sun and a blue sky.
festival-dawn.note: EH-3 in the festival town street, LIGHT sunset (low sun) + clear; the open world did render and screenshot on SwiftShader (an earlier tool note said it could not)
